подтема: что делает thinking у image-моделей Gemini 3
content_en: The image model is a thinking model: it uses a reasoning process ("Thinking") for complex prompts.
applies_when_en: The prompt is complex (many linked conditions, spatial logic, data or an infographic, or an open request to come up with the content), and the prompt author decides how much to spell out and whether to trust the model to plan the composition.
not_applies_when_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana), where thinking is not supported; questions of thinking levels, billing and thought signatures, which are separate rules; the Gemini app, where "Thinking" is a menu item.
caveats_en: Designed to tackle the most challenging image generation by incorporating state-of-the-art reasoning capabilities; its ability to think before it creates sets it apart; described as the flagship model with advanced reasoning (thinking) (models: pro).
Included among the Gemini 3 image models (models: lite).
Image generation follows real-world logic thanks to advanced reasoning capabilities (models: unspecified).
Thinking evaluates prompt instructions and plans the visual composition before generating the image (models: pro, nb2).
Built on the Gemini 3 family of models, the models apply deep reasoning capabilities to fully understand the prompt before generating an image (models: pro, nb2).

The model uses reasoning to think through a prompt and can retrieve real-time data, such as weather forecasts or stock charts, through Google Search grounding before generating high-fidelity images (models: pro, nb2).

Thinking models are trained to generate an internal thinking process before producing a response; as a result they are capable of stronger reasoning, multi-step planning, mathematical problem-solving and code generation than models without thinking capabilities (models: unspecified).
canaries_en: Create an infographic comparing the planets with accurate data
Design a scene with many objects in precise spatial relationships
Come up with a creative poster concept on your own

terms.значение_en: The model's reasoning process before it produces the image.
The reasoning process ("Thinking") that Gemini 3 image models use for complex prompts before generating.
The model's ability to reason through the prompt before generating; Google uses it as a synonym for thinking.
Models trained to generate an internal thinking process before producing a response; Gemini 3 image models are called thinking models.
What thinking does in image models, per the cookbook: evaluate prompt instructions and plan the visual composition before generating the image.
Reasoning that Nano Banana models apply to fully understand the prompt before generating an image.

title_en: Review thought summaries to improve prompts
content_en: Review reasoning: analyze thought summaries to understand failures and improve prompts.
applies_when_en: The image does not match the prompt and it is unclear which condition the model misread; before rewriting the prompt.
not_applies_when_en: The thought summary is empty (images can have no thought text; see the rule on empty summaries); Nano Banana 2.5.
caveats_en: The step-by-step "thought process" the model generates can be viewed to understand how it interprets the prompt before creating the image (models: pro).

подтема: промпт: не просить модель расписывать рассуждения (общая механика)
title_en: No need to request reasoning steps
content_en: The model automatically generates internal "thinking" text to improve reasoning performance, so it is generally not necessary to have the model outline, plan or detail reasoning steps in the returned response itself.
applies_when_en: Out of habit from text models, the prompt asks the model to first write out a plan or step-by-step reasoning, or to think really hard.
not_applies_when_en: Image models are not named directly (a general Gemini 2.5 and 3 mechanism); on image models the depth of thinking is set by thinking_level.
forbids_in_output_en: outline, plan, or detail reasoning steps in the returned response
